margins.source: the plan's own null from cell PLANr (read 2026-09-22): h_SLU 1.2485, h_intent 0.9943 (docs/results/2026-09-22-slurp-planr-v2-lock-replicate-verdict.md, section 1)

cell_kind: EFFICIENCY -- the efficiency tables are the deliverable; the paired score read is a non-inferiority guard
claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows, plus a cost measurement of the same flight. No superiority, generalization, component-causal, bar or confirmatory claim; no cross-carrier claim; no geometry claim.

decision_rule.rule: see protocol-registered-v1.json decision_rule (NEUTRAL / ADMITTED / HARMFUL / acquisition_diagnostic)

delta_convention: delta = PLAN minus the sealed anchor, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: FINITE COMPLETIONS. The count of rows whose terminal_disposition.reason is "finite_completion", the affected sample ids, the delivered-draft versus abstention split, and -- only if the count is non-zero -- the primary official metric recomputed with those rows excluded BESIDE the registered all-rows number, which stays the number the decision rule reads. No row is ever filtered out of the scored manifest. Expected zero; the anchor side is provably zero (docs/receipts/slurp-finite-completion-exposure-v1.json).

planner_action_illegal. The flight's own count, the sample ids that carry it, and their action character counts and SHA-256 values (the form inherited from the B7a recovery note's section 8). This is the failure item E8c repaired; it is reported whether or not it is zero.

FIRST-REQUEST BYTE IDENTITY, stated honestly before contact. Under this arm the first request of a row (Perception) is NOT byte-identical to the base's: the slot-contract cards it carries are the v2 release's (M4b). Claimed and proven by the smoke: no request carries a tools array; one normaliser receipt per row; the Reviewer and Planner requests differ from the base's only through upstream content.
THE CONSTANCY TABLE per row from the sealed receipt: mode, rendered_tool_names, the five contact rows with authority_tool_names beside rendered_tool_names, and distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1.

NATIVE TASK-CONTRACT CALL COUNT against the anchor's realized 1,082, and the count of tool calls emitted by a role that holds no authority (expected zero; a non-zero count is not a failure of the flight -- the rail refuses the call and the episode continues -- but it is the single most interesting behavioural consequence of showing three more roles the tool definitions, and it is reported per role).

PER-SCENARIO intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios, in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-scenario weighting, plus net harmed rows per scenario with any scenario of five or more flagged (owner decision 17) -- a diagnostic the verdict must carry, not an additional gate.
ROW ACCOUNTING: 1,080 in, 1,080 out on both sides, no row dropped and no sample_id invented.

COST: actual generation contacts against the anchor's realized 5,417 and the 11,880 ceiling; actual repeated speech seconds against the anchor's realized 15,459.76; actual FIT endpoints; GPU hours read from the serving monitor over the lease window.
ACQUISITION RECEIPTS: as the protocol's item.
efficiency_tables_required: HEADLINE EFFICIENCY: prefilled tokens per row, GPU hours per 1,080 rows, wall seconds per row, contacts per row, aggregate prefill tok/s and aggregate decode tok/s -- PLAN beside the anchor's own realized cost block and beside the B4b reference, with every number's source named (run manifest, flight receipts, monitor, or server.log).

PER-POSITION TABLE over the five positions perception / solver / reviewer 1 / reviewer 2 / planner: prompt tokens, prefilled tokens, cached share, generated tokens, speech-packet re-decode share and prefilled tokens per row -- PLAN beside the B4b reference of arms.efficiency_reference_not_an_arm, with the reference labelled as a reference on every row.
CONSTANCY: distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 per row (must be 1 on all 1,080), rendered_tool_names, and authority_tool_names per role -- from the sealed saea-native-tool-schema-rendering-v1 block.

PREFILL JOIN QUALITY: the share of contacts on which n_tokens - generated + 1 equals the client's usage.prompt_tokens. Below 100.00 % the per-role figures are reported as estimates, not measurements, and the verdict says so.
CLIENT PROMPT TOKENS per row and the per-contact delta at each of the three tool-free positions, stated as an EXPECTED RISE and explicitly not a regression.
SLOT OCCUPANCY AND UTILISATION over the lease window: mean busy slots, zero-busy share, parked fraction, mean utilisation, GPU power -- from flight receipts and monitor.jsonl.

estimators.not_used: analysis.score_compare_cli as the runner: it hard-codes ci_level 0.90 and DEV population names

metrics.counts: tp = [slu_f1_word_tp, slu_f1_char_tp], fp and fn likewise

output.harness_admission: on NEUTRAL the coordinator writes the harness-admission entry in the form the protocol document's harness_admission_entry_form records, and adds the key to the SLURP default plan
output.prints_only_aggregates: no utterance text, no filler and no gold is printed or persisted by the read

resampling.clusters: 125 speaker clusters, 18 scenarios of 60 rows, 523 headset and 557 far-field rows, from the released roster metadata
resampling.interval_form: percentile pairs of the same retained replicate sequence
resampling.pairing_note: both sides of this contrast are decoded runs, so the paired interval carries real decoding noise; the own-null margins are the calibration for exactly that. A NON-INFERIORITY read is the correct shape here precisely because the expected true effect is zero.
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed

scorer.projection_v3_companion: slurp-slu-official-projected-v3-train, reported beside every official number (owner decision 7)
scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer
scorer.symmetric_normalised_companion: slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1-train, the TRAIN sibling registered under owner decision 14, reported beside every official number

tables_required: headline score: the anchor, PLAN, the delta, speaker CI95, speaker CI90, the scenario-stratified CI90 and the equal-scenario delta, for official pooled SLU-F1 and intent
per-scenario intent and SLU over all 18 scenarios, in both weightings
net harmed rows per scenario, with any scenario of five or more flagged (owner decision 17)
saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p
projection v3 and the TRAIN symmetric number beside every official number
the mandatory diagnostics of the protocol document's diagnostics_required, in order
the frontier row: official SLU-F1 delta x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 1,080 rows, pooled and per scenario (decision 75)
the acquisition tables: ACQUIRE routes per row, items acquired, saves / harms restricted to the acquired rows beside the unacquired rows
